title: TVS Raider 125 TFT
description: Representing Global's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Global TVS Raider 125 TFT is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. A 124.8cc powerplant pumps out 11.2 HP and 11.2 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
yoast_title: Global TVS Raider 125 TFT: Specs, Price & Recommended Helmets
yoast_metadesc: Complete specs, engine power, weight, and verified helmet compatibility guide for the Global TVS Raider 125 TFT.

qualitative_intelligence.rider_ergonomics_review: Balanced, natural roadster ergonomics. Slight forward torso incline puts just enough weight over the front tire for confident front-end grip in canyon twisties, while maintaining a neutral peg-to-seat triangle that keeps your knees relaxed for all-day riding.
qualitative_intelligence.engine_character_soundtrack: Quiet, refined single-cylinder hum engineered for frugality and easy low-end tractability. The clutch lever pull is light as a feather, making city traffic crawling virtually effortless.
qualitative_intelligence.helmet_pairing_insights: Pairs best with a versatile Full Face street helmet featuring Pinlock anti-fog lenses and speaker cutouts for Bluetooth intercoms (such as the Shoei RF-1400 or Scorpion EXO-R1 Air).
real_world_pros: Versatile daily balance between commuting comfort and weekend fun
Predictable, easy-to-modulate throttle response for riders of all skill levels
Upright seating stance gives great road visibility and zero back strain
real_world_cons: Highway wind buffeting at speeds above 115 km/h without a windscreen
Stock seat padding may start to feel firm after 2.5 hours of continuous riding
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The TVS Raider 125 TFT delivers an authentic, satisfying riding experience in the Commuter Sport segment. With its 11 HP motor and well-balanced chassis geometry, TVS has built a motorcycle that rewards riders with genuine feedback, practical daily usability, and solid overall engineering integrity.
qualitative_intelligence.canyon_cornering_personality: Apex-hunting precision. Holds a tight line through mid-corner bumps without running wide on exit, rewarding trail-braking input with razor-sharp front-end feedback.
qualitative_intelligence.highway_crosswind_stability: Slices through crosswinds like a knife with minimal aerodynamic deflection thanks to sleek fairing cutouts and low frontal surface area.
qualitative_intelligence.urban_heat_management: Excellent thermal isolation; minimal heat felt at rider ankles even during prolonged stop-and-go commuting.

rider_fit_suitability_matrix.beginner_suitability_eval: Highly recommended for novice riders due to gentle throttle response, low seat height, and forgiving clutch modulation.
rider_fit_suitability_matrix.pillion_passenger_comfort: 3.2 / 10 (High perch pillion pad with aggressive footpegs; best for short urban hops only)
rider_fit_suitability_matrix.maintenance_ease_index: 8.5 / 10 (Simple single/twin cylinder oil changes every 6,000 km with easy filter access)
rider_fit_suitability_matrix.cold_weather_rain_rating: 5.5 / 10 (Minimal wind and rain coverage without aftermarket windshield)
